summary.text: Mike Gaskill is a Republican Indiana state senator who represents District 25 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Gaskill graduated from Pendleton Heights High School and earned degrees in accounting and computer science from Anderson University, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes owning a business, working as a business systems manager with Praxair Surface Technologies, and working as an insurance agent.
Ballotpedia lists Gaskill as having served in the Indiana State Senate since 2018 and as representing District 25 since November 9, 2022.
For the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Elections Committee and is also assigned to the Family & Children Services, Insurance and Financial Institutions, and Tax and Fiscal Policy committees.
